title: Arkret Principal Authority Instance
description: Immutable selector for one account/PCR authority lineage. principal_id answers identity equality; the remaining fields select exactly one independently controlled PCR on one Principal Server. The digest is SHA-256 over UTF8('ak.principal-authority-instance.v1\n') followed by RFC 8785 JCS of the first four fields in schema order. Equal principal_id or equal public keys never merge instances.

principal_server_id.description: Service did_core_id of the Principal Server that accepted this PCR genesis. It is not a globally current service pointer.

pcr_realm_id.description: Event-derived PCR Realm id committed by the signed genesis receipt.

principal_genesis_receipt_digest.description: Digest of the complete signed pcr_genesis_unit receipt. Receivers verify that receipt and its reverse binding to principal_id, principal_server_id and pcr_realm_id.
